subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr rolls his eyes and responds with indifference to the demand for a speech and agreement on leadership.

subject: the captain
fact: The captain shouts for more mead, offers to pay for it, and instructs Zephyr to speak with Pasmarie Clee regarding an ongoing issue.
source_quote: The captain shouts, “Mari, give them some more mead. I’ll pay for it..” He then turns to Zephyr and says, “You should talk to Pasmarie Clee. She’s been bugging me about this.”

subject: Calmer
